hookups.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/fairy-stone ('All sites listed above have electric and water hook-ups, no sewer'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Main campground (renovated, paved, shaded): Red sites take RVs to 35 ft, pop-ups and tents (gravel tent pad); Green sites take RVs to 35 ft or pop-ups only, no tents; all electric and water. The 10-site equestrian campground (electric/water with 20/30/50-amp, gravel pull-throughs to 50 ft, pit toilets, no shade) takes non-horse campers only for sites not reserved within 30 days of the date. Group camp is tents only.

sites.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/fairy-stone ('Red sites, up to 35' RVs, pop-ups, tents', 'Green sites, no tents; up to 35' RVs or pop-ups only', Equestrian Camp: 'Total sites: 10', 'Non-horse campers may camp here if a site has not been reserved within 30 days before the desired date'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: No laundry in the park ('East of the park, Stanleytown has laundry facilities and Stuart'). Camp store/gift shop and snack bar listed among park facilities.

facilities.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/fairy-stone ('Central bathhouse with running water and hot showers', 'No sewer hookups, but there is a dump station', 'LAUNDRY: East of the park, Stanleytown has laundry facilities', facility list 'Camp Store/Gift Shop'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'All campsites can be specifically reserved by site number'; most site numbers changed in the renovation.

summary: Confirmed reservable by site number; season already manual. Added water (no sewer) at every main-campground site, RVs to 35 ft, showers/dump/camp store, no laundry. Fees left as human-checked 2026-10-12. Not stated on the park page: electric amperage for the main campground, site count, booking window/cutoff/max stay (left inherited); the booking site's per-site details could not be read (its API answered 403).
